text:
Marta: Heads up — pelican-v2 int4 bringup surfaced locale regressions: CJK token boundary drift (zh/ja) and bracket mirroring for RTL. attaching minimal repro and quick metrics.
Kei: can you drop a failing string?
Marta: sure — short repro:
Marta: zh input: "\u5546\u54c1\u8aaa\u660e(\u4fee\u8abf\u7248)"
Marta: pelican-v2 int4 detok: "\u5546\u54c1 \u8aaa\u660e\u4fee\u8abf \u7248 )"  <-- unexpected spaces and bracket ends up on wrong side for rtl examples
Owen: that looks like a subtoken boundary change rather than purely quantization noise
Ravi: quick metrics snapshot vs pelican-fp16 baseline: WMT-zh-en BLEU -0.45 (shortctx), chrF -1.8, multilingual-embed cosine -0.06 on eval shard
Marta: token id diff (truncated):
```
- ... 210, 4410, 59, 900
+ ... 210, 441, 059, 900
```
Marta: you can see a subtoken split/merge shifted the window
Kei: repro command I used:
```
./tools/eval_local --model pelican-v2 --quant int4 --detok-mode permissive --samples tests/locale/pelican_samples.json
```
Kei: reproduced locally; tokenmap offset appears for vocab IDs in range ~4300-4600 after precompile reorder commit a1c3f2e
Ravi: note: fp16->int4 and fp16->int8 both show the same boundary shift when precomp ordering is applied, so quantization amplifies but is not the fundamental cause
Eval-bot: CI guardrail: 8/1500 failing samples (0.53%) above threshold 0.25% — failures concentrated in CJK short sequences and mixed JP-kana patterns
Marta: short-term mitigation I sketched (post-detok normalization) — ugly but reduces customer-visible diffs:
```
# post-detok quickfix (python)
import re
s = re.sub(r'([\u4e00-\u9fff])([()\[\]{}])', r'\1 \2', s)
if is_rtl(s):
    s = s.replace('(', '\\uff08').replace(')', '\\uff09')
```
Owen: acceptable as a bandage during rollout, but we need a solid bisect and fix
Kei: starting git bisect with a1c3f2e as first-bad; will test tokenmap-only rollback and then kernel pins (runtime 2.3.1 vs 2.4.0)
Ravi: plan: (1) confirm culprit via bisect, (2) run full eval matrix (40k samples) with tokenmap rollback x kernel pins, (3) add unit tests under tests/locale/pelican_edgecases.json capturing the exact boundary/bracket patterns, (4) ship revert or deterministic precompile ordering patch
Kei: adding reproducer script at repro/localize_pelican.sh and test vectors pelican_zh_jp_brackets.json and pelican_ar_bracket_mirror.json
Marta: FYI Dedicated customers may be running pinned runtimes; flagging @oncall and @eng-runtime for potential increased error rate during canary rollout
Eval-bot: scheduled full run 3191000500 (40k samples) to collect comprehensive delta matrix
Marta: I'll open a PR with the post-detok mitigation + tests and include bisect notes once complete. tagging @eng-ml-leads for prioritization.
Owen: thanks — if bisect confirms, coordinate rollback window with eng-runtime and ops.
Marta: thx everyone :thumbsup:
